ACADIA
2010
IT’S ALL THAT.
Acadia brings together everything you’re looking for in one brilliantly realized
crossover vehicle. For starters, there’s Acadia’s athletic good looks and
spacious, versatile, well-equipped interior. Not to mention excellent all-
season traction, with the option of a high-tech all-wheel-drive system. On
the road, Acadia delivers the performance, handling and overall refi nement
of a premium sedan. Yet at the same time, it offers the highest cargo and
towing capacities in its class.* Acadia also delivers the best fuel effi ciency
of any eight-passenger crossover,** thanks to advanced technologies like
Direct Injection, Variable Valve Timing (VVT) and a six-speed automatic
transmission. Add in a fi ve-star safety rating† and the fact that Acadia was
named a “Top Safety Pick 2009” by the Insurance Institute for Highway
Safety (IIHS)†† and you’ve got a combination that’s impossible to resist.
Presenting the professional grade 2010 Acadia from GMC. It’s all that.

EXTERIOR
ACADIA
MADE YOU LOOK.
Acadia is one crossover vehicle that’s impossible to ignore. The lines are
clean yet muscular, and the long wheelbase and broad front and rear tracks
add an athletic stance. There’s a GMC-signature grille that signals Acadia’s
professional-grade heritage, and a close look is rewarded by a host of premium
details, including fast-illuminating LED tail lights. The Acadia body is also as
functional as it is beautiful. During the development process, GMC’s engineers
spent more than 5000 hours in the wind tunnel, refi ning every detail. The
result: a drag coeffi cient of just 0.344, so you enjoy a calm, quiet highway
ride and improved fuel effi ciency.

INTERIOR
ACADIA
GO AHEAD, SPOIL THEM.
Acadia is a refi ned, comfortable and entertaining way for as many as eight
fortunate people to get around. The cabin is attractively styled and, with a
wheelbase over three metres long, remarkably spacious. The driver and front
passenger can enjoy the four-season luxury of available heated and cooled
bucket seats. For your rear passengers, entry and exit into the third row are a
breeze, thanks to Acadia’s low ride height and the SmartSlideTM second-row
seats. There’s also an excellent range of entertainment choices, including an
available rear DVD entertainment system complete with Bose® 5.1 surround
sound audio. Add it all together and you’ve got an elegant, luxurious cabin
that’s equipped to spoil every occupant.

ultrasonic rear parking assist and Head-Up Display (HUD) instrumentation
that signifi cantly lessens your need to take your eyes off the road. It all
pays off in a real sense of control when you’re behind the wheel.

VERSATILITY
ACADIA
MADE TO MULTI-TASK.
Kids. Groceries. Grandparents. Snowboards. Camping gear. Luggage. The
boat. Whoever and whatever you need to carry, Acadia is the perfect solution.
Acadia’s versatility starts with an interior large enough to accommodate eight
people and their gear with ease. SmartSlide second-row seats can be eased
forward with one hand when you have passengers accessing the third-row seats.
Any time you need more cargo space, the second- and third-row seatbacks
also fold fl at to create up to 3283 litres of room – the most in Acadia’s class.*
An available power liftgate and a low 780 mm liftover height make loading
and unloading a breeze. And the boat? When equipped with the Trailer Towing
Package, a best-in-class maximum trailer rating of 2359 kg (5200 lb.),* Acadia
is ready to make the run to the lake any time you are.
* Based on 2009 GM Mid-Utility Crossover segment and latest available competitive information at time of printing. Excludes other GM
vehicles. Cargo and load capacity limited by weight and distribution.
All Acadia 2nd-row seats incorporate
a SmartSlide feature that allows them
to be moved forward with one hand for
easy access to the 3rd-row seat. As the
seatback slides further forward, the rear
of the seat cushion automatically moves
up and forward to maximize space.

ONSTAR
Does your vehicle have a help
button? If you have OnStar*, you
can get the help you need at the
push of a button. If you’re in a
collision, you don’t even need to ask for help – sensors
around your car can automatically alert an OnStar Advisor.
If your vehicle is stolen, we can use GPS technology to
help police fi nd it. OnStar and 1 year of the Directions &
Connections Plan is included on all Acadia models.
An integral part of the Directions & Connections Plan is
Turn-by-Turn Navigation** – the simplest and smartest
navigation system available. Just push the OnStar button
and tell the Advisor where you want to go, and turn-by-turn
directions are downloaded to your vehicle. No one offers
more ways to help on the road. Learn more at onstar.ca
* OnStar services require vehicle electrical system (including battery), wireless service
and GPS satellite signals to be available and operating for features to function
properly. OnStar acts as a link to existing emergency service providers. Subscription
Service Agreement required. Ability to locate stolen vehicles varies with conditions.
Call 1-888-4-ONSTAR (1-888-466-7827) or visit onstar.ca for OnStar’s Terms and
Conditions, Privacy Statement and details and system limitations.
** Turn-by-Turn Navigation not available in certain areas. Visit onstar.ca for
coverage map.
XM SATELLITE RADIO
Your listening preferences are very
personal. XM Satellite Radio gives
you access to the largest playlist on
the planet and the most commercial-free music in digital-
quality sound. That’s on top of news, talk, comedy and
sports channels – including more than 1000 NHL games.
It all adds up to 130 channels to choose from, coast to
coast.† Why offer so much choice? XM Satellite Radio
has to appeal to a wide range of tastes, with more than
9 million subscribers. And it’s included on all Acadia
models. Ask your dealer for more information.
† Available in 10 Canadian provinces and the 48 contiguous United States.
Subscription sold separately after trial period.
